title.zh-CN: 口干多饮后呕吐、气促 · 25岁男性
title.en: Thirst, then vomiting and breathlessness · 25-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 一位年轻男性口干多饮一个多月、体重明显下降，近几天呕吐，昨天起喘得厉害：在急诊弄清他为什么这样呼吸、查体还发现了什么，再沿着记录的住院经过复盘。
summary.en: A young man with over a month of thirst and marked weight loss has been vomiting for days and badly breathless since yesterday: work out in the emergency department why he is breathing like this and what else the examination shows, then follow his recorded admission.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——25岁男性，口干多饮一个多月、一个月内体重下降约 10 kg、近 3 天乏力恶心并呕吐咖啡渣样物、入院前 1 天明显呼吸困难；既往无糖尿病、高血压和慢性肺病；入院查体（心率、呼吸、握雪感、呼吸音）；血糖、尿酮、血气、钠、钾、肌酐；胸部 CT 与之后的胃镜；记录的治疗与结局——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（血压、体温、血氧、意识状态、体重、其余化验、治疗方案和剂量、颈部引流指征、糖尿病分型依据）保持未知。保留的 1.0.0 版内部不一致：其教学文字提到“纠酸”措施，而其结局记录只列出补液、胰岛素、胃肠减压和颈部引流——本版不认定用过碱剂，列为待核实；钠的单位在 1.0.0 版中与钾合写为 mmol/L；主诉写口干多饮“一个月”，病史写“一个多月”。原报告图 1 已获准在本地展示，随结局记录供复盘。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 25-year-old man with over a month of thirst and heavy drinking, about 10 kg of weight loss in a month, three days of weakness, nausea and coffee-ground vomiting, and marked breathlessness from the day before admission; no previous diabetes, hypertension or chronic lung disease; the admission examination (pulse, breathing, crepitus, breath sounds); glucose, urine ketones, blood gas, sodium, potassium and creatinine; the chest CT and the later gastroscopy; the recorded treatment and outcome — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (blood pressure, temperature, saturation, conscious level, weight, the rest of the laboratory work, treatment regimens and doses, the reason for cervical drainage, the basis for classifying his diabetes) stays unknown. Inconsistencies of version 1.0.0 kept: its teaching text refers to an acid-correction step while its outcome record lists only fluids, insulin, gastric decompression and cervical drainage — this version does not assert that alkali was given and lists the point to verify; the sodium's unit is written jointly with the potassium's (mmol/L); the chief complaint gives one month of thirst, the history over a month. The report's figure 1 is approved for local display and is shown with the outcome record for the review.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据血糖、酮体和血气诊断糖尿病酮症酸中毒并分级，决定治疗地点（2024 年 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS 共识；JBDS-IP 2023 的 2 级监护指标）。
learningOutcomes.en: Diagnose and grade diabetic ketoacidosis from the glucose, ketones and blood gas, and choose the place of care (2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS consensus; JBDS-IP 2023 markers for level-2 care).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用 Winter 公式判断严重代谢性酸中毒的最大呼吸代偿，并说明为什么深快呼吸不是无创通气的指征（BTS/ICS 2016），以及镇静或通气量不足的机械通气为何危险。
learningOutcomes.en: Use Winter's formula to recognise maximal respiratory compensation in severe metabolic acidosis, and explain why Kussmaul breathing is not an indication for NIV (BTS/ICS 2016) and why sedation or under-set ventilation is dangerous.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 开始第一个小时的治疗——等渗液、0.1 单位/(kg·h) 的固定速率胰岛素、血钾 3.5–5.5 mmol/L 时补钾、pH ≥ 7.0 不用碳酸氢钠——并按校正后约 118–121 mmol/L 的血钠调整液体和监测（2024 年共识；JBDS-IP 2023；2014 年欧洲低钠血症指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Start first-hour treatment — isotonic fluid, a fixed-rate insulin infusion of 0.1 units/kg/h, potassium replacement at 3.5–5.5 mmol/L and no bicarbonate at pH 7.0 or above — and adapt fluids and monitoring to a glucose-corrected sodium of about 118–121 mmol/L (2024 consensus; JBDS-IP 2023; European hyponatraemia guideline 2014).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别呕吐后颈胸部握雪感提示的胸腔内漏气，在影像排除食管破裂前禁食，并先行 CT 再考虑内镜（WSES 2019）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise crepitus at the neck and chest after vomiting as air escaping from the chest, keep the patient nil by mouth and image with CT before any endoscopy until oesophageal rupture is excluded (WSES 2019).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解读显示纵隔气肿而无裂口的 CT：选择保守处理和持续观察，并把颈部引流留给积气危及气道、呼吸或循环的情况。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a CT showing pneumomediastinum without a tear: choose conservative care with surveillance, and keep cervical drainage for air that threatens the airway, breathing or circulation.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制订停用静脉胰岛素和出院的计划——纠正标准、停泵前 1–2 小时给基础胰岛素、用胰岛自身抗体分型、糖尿病教育和生病期间规则（2024 年共识；ADA 2026 糖尿病诊疗标准）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan the step-down from intravenous insulin and discharge — resolution criteria, basal insulin 1–2 hours before the infusion stops, classification by islet autoantibodies, education and sick-day rules (2024 consensus; ADA Standards of Care 2026).

personality.zh-CN: 25岁男性，口干、消瘦了一个多月，这几天又吐又喘，人很难受，也有些害怕。问到什么答什么，只说自己清楚的事；不清楚的就直说说不上来，从不猜。
personality.en: A 25-year-old man who has been thirsty and losing weight for over a month and is now vomiting and fighting for breath — wretched and a little frightened. He answers what he is asked, says only what he knows, and when he does not know he says so rather than guess.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语、短句，一句话要分几口气说完；不用医学术语。
speechStyle.en: Plain, short phrases, broken up by his breathing; no medical terms.

openingLine.en: Doctor… I can't get my breath…

concerns.zh-CN: 医生，我是不是得了什么大病？

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：他躺在推床上，呼吸又深又快，说几个字就要停下来喘口气，显得疲惫、害怕。只回答被问到的内容；不提检查结果或化验数值，不编造病史、用药或过敏。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: he lies on the trolley breathing deeply and fast, stopping every few words to catch his breath, tired and frightened. He answers only what he is asked, never mentions test results or laboratory values, and never invents history, medicines or allergies.

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：25岁男性，既往无糖尿病、高血压或慢性肺病。口干、多饮一个多月，近一个月体重下降约 10 kg；近 3 天食欲下降、乏力、恶心，呕吐咖啡渣样物；入院前 1 天明显呼吸困难。入院时心率 120 次/分，呼吸 40 次/分、深大急促；颈部、前胸和腹壁可触及握雪感，双肺呼吸音低。血糖 26.3 mmol/L，尿酮 14.4 mmol/L，pH 7.10，HCO₃⁻ 3.1 mmol/L，PaCO₂ 10 mmHg；钠 112 mmol/L，钾 3.8 mmol/L，肌酐 217 µmol/L。CT 示纵隔及皮下积气、食管扩张，未见明确的食管或气管撕裂；之后的胃镜见咖啡渣样物和十二指肠充血，未发现明显的食管或胃壁穿孔。经补液、胰岛素、胃肠减压和颈部引流后病情改善，积气约 1 周基本吸收，此后化验恢复，住院约 2 周出院，随访 2 年未复发。
text.en: Recorded course: a 25-year-old man with no previous diabetes, hypertension or chronic lung disease. Over a month of dry mouth and heavy drinking, with about 10 kg of weight loss over the past month; three days of poor appetite, weakness, nausea and coffee-ground vomiting; marked breathlessness from the day before admission. On admission his heart rate was 120/min and his breathing deep and rapid at 40/min; there was crepitus at the neck, front of the chest and abdominal wall, and breath sounds were reduced on both sides. Glucose 26.3 mmol/L, urine ketones 14.4 mmol/L, pH 7.10, HCO₃⁻ 3.1 mmol/L, PaCO₂ 10 mmHg; sodium 112 mmol/L, potassium 3.8 mmol/L, creatinine 217 µmol/L. CT showed mediastinal and subcutaneous air and a dilated oesophagus with no definite oesophageal or tracheal tear; a later gastroscopy found coffee-ground material and duodenal congestion, with no obvious perforation of the oesophagus or stomach wall. He improved after fluids, insulin, gastric decompression and cervical drainage; the air had largely resorbed within about a week, his laboratory values later recovered, he was discharged after about two weeks, and there was no recurrence over two years of follow-up.

dose.en: 0.9 % sodium chloride or a balanced crystalloid: about 1 L in the first hour if there is no hypotension, then 500–1,000 mL/h for 2–4 hours by protocol, adjusted to blood pressure, urine output and sodium; in adults aged 18–25, replace fluid steadily with neurological observations.

name.zh-CN: 固定速率静脉胰岛素输注

dose.zh-CN: 常规（可溶性）胰岛素经注射泵静脉输注，固定速率 0.1 单位/(kg·h)（无法称重时按估计体重），不推注负荷量；血钾已知且 ≥ 3.5 mmol/L 时开始；血糖降到 14 mmol/L 以下时加 10% 葡萄糖，胰岛素持续到酮症酸中毒纠正。
dose.en: Soluble (regular) insulin by syringe pump at a fixed 0.1 units/kg/h (by estimated weight if he cannot be weighed), no loading bolus; start once the potassium is known to be at least 3.5 mmol/L; add 10 % glucose when the glucose falls below 14 mmol/L and continue the insulin until the ketoacidosis has resolved.

harm.zh-CN: 血钾结果出来之前不要开始胰岛素：如果血钾低于 3.5 mmol/L，胰岛素会把钾进一步驱入细胞内，可引起致命的心律失常和呼吸肌无力。2024 年 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS 共识要求此时先补钾、推迟胰岛素；先测钾，再开泵。
harm.en: Do not start insulin before the potassium is known: below 3.5 mmol/L, insulin drives potassium further into the cells and can cause fatal arrhythmia and respiratory-muscle weakness. The 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS consensus replaces potassium and delays insulin in that case — measure first, then start the pump.

response.zh-CN: 胰岛素泵已开始。报告记录了胰岛素治疗，但本病例没有记录方案和剂量；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The insulin infusion is running. The report records insulin treatment, but this case does not record the regimen or doses; it does not simulate the effect.

name.en: Potassium chloride added to the IV fluid

dose.zh-CN: 血钾 3.5–5.5 mmol/L 时，每升液体加氯化钾 40 mmol（JBDS-IP 2023；2024 年共识认为多数患者每升 20–30 mmol 即可，> 5.0 mmol/L 时不补），经输液泵输注，持续心电监护；开始后 1–2 小时复查血钾；尿量少或肾功能受损时先请上级医师评估。绝不静脉推注。
dose.en: While potassium is 3.5–5.5 mmol/L, 40 mmol of potassium chloride in each litre of fluid (JBDS-IP 2023; the 2024 consensus finds 20–30 mmol/L enough for most and gives none above 5.0 mmol/L), by volumetric pump on continuous ECG monitoring; recheck potassium 1–2 hours after starting, and ask a senior first if urine output is low or kidney function is impaired. Never as an IV push.

harm.zh-CN: 血钾结果出来之前不要补钾：如果他其实是高钾血症（脱水和肾功能受损时都可能出现），盲目补钾可能引起致命的心律失常。先测钾，再按结果补（JBDS-IP 2023）。
harm.en: Do not add potassium before the level is known: if he were hyperkalaemic — possible with dehydration or impaired kidneys — it could cause a fatal arrhythmia. Measure first, then replace by the result (JBDS-IP 2023).

response.zh-CN: 钾已加入补液。本病例没有记录是否补钾及补钾量；不模拟其效果。

dose.zh-CN: 5% 碳酸氢钠静脉滴注纠正酸中毒。
dose.en: 5 % sodium bicarbonate by IV infusion to correct the acidosis.

harm.zh-CN: 2024 年 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS 共识只在 pH < 7.0 时才考虑碳酸氢钠；pH 在此之上时它不能加快恢复，却会在胰岛素起效后加重低钾、增加钠负荷，并可能延缓酮体清除。补液和胰岛素本身就能纠正酸中毒；还没看血气时，先测 pH。
harm.en: The 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS consensus considers bicarbonate only below pH 7.0; above that it does not speed recovery, but deepens hypokalaemia once insulin acts, adds a sodium load and may slow ketone clearance. Fluids and insulin correct the acidosis — and if the gas has not been read, measure the pH first.

response.zh-CN: 已给予。本病例没有记录是否用过碱剂；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record whether any alkali was given; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 0.45% 氯化钠 1 L 静脉快速输注。
dose.en: 0.45 % sodium chloride 1 L IV, run fast.

harm.zh-CN: 低渗液不是酮症酸中毒的起始液体（2024 年共识先用等渗液）。血钠低时尤其危险：低渗液会让血钠和渗透压进一步下降，在 18–25 岁的年轻成人中增加脑水肿风险。先看血钠及其经血糖校正后的数值，再选液体。
harm.en: Hypotonic fluid is not the starting fluid in DKA (the 2024 consensus starts with isotonic fluid). It is most dangerous when the sodium is low: it pushes sodium and osmolality lower still and adds to the risk of cerebral oedema in young adults aged 18–25. Read the sodium and its glucose-corrected value before choosing the fluid.

response.zh-CN: 正在输注。本病例没有记录用过低渗液；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Running. This case records no hypotonic fluid; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 面罩无创正压通气，按呼吸窘迫程度设置参数。
dose.en: Face-mask non-invasive positive-pressure ventilation, set for his work of breathing.

harm.zh-CN: 无创通气用于高碳酸血症性呼吸衰竭（BTS/ICS 2016：经规范治疗后 pH < 7.35 且 PaCO₂ > 6.5 kPa）；使 PaCO₂ 降低的深快呼吸不是这种情况，正压也治不了它的病因。他近几天呕吐，正压面罩会增加误吸风险；如果有气体从胸腔漏到颈部皮下，正压还会把更多气体压入纵隔和胸膜腔，可能引起张力性气胸。先找出并治疗呼吸深快的原因，担心气道时请上级医师共同评估。
harm.en: NIV treats hypercapnic respiratory failure (BTS/ICS 2016: pH < 7.35 with PaCO₂ > 6.5 kPa despite standard treatment); deep, fast breathing that drives the PaCO₂ down is not that, and positive pressure does nothing for its cause. He has been vomiting, so a positive-pressure mask adds aspiration; and if air is leaking from the chest into the neck, positive pressure drives more of it into the mediastinum and pleura and can cause a tension pneumothorax. Find and treat the cause of the breathing, and involve a senior if the airway is a concern.

response.zh-CN: 无创通气已连接。本病例没有记录他用过任何通气支持；不模拟其效果。
response.en: NIV is on. This case records no ventilatory support of any kind; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 皮下基础胰岛素（与静脉胰岛素重叠）
name.en: Subcutaneous basal insulin, overlapping the infusion

dose.zh-CN: 酮症酸中毒纠正（血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L，且静脉 pH ≥ 7.3 或 HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18 mmol/L）并能进食后，皮下注射长效（基础）胰岛素并配合餐时胰岛素；首剂基础胰岛素后 1–2 小时再停静脉胰岛素。
dose.en: Once the ketoacidosis has resolved (ketones < 0.6 mmol/L with venous pH ≥ 7.3 or bicarbonate ≥ 18 mmol/L) and he is eating: long-acting (basal) insulin subcutaneously with mealtime insulin, and the IV insulin stopped 1–2 hours after the first basal dose.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录他停用静脉胰岛素的方式和出院时的降糖方案；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record how the infusion was stopped or his glucose-lowering treatment at discharge; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 糖尿病自我管理教育与生病期间规则
name.en: Diabetes self-management education and sick-day rules

dose.zh-CN: 由糖尿病专科团队进行：胰岛素注射与剂量调整、血糖和血酮自测、低血糖的识别和处理、生病时不停基础胰岛素并每 2–4 小时测血糖和血酮、何时返院；安排专科随访。
dose.en: By the diabetes team: insulin injection and dose adjustment, glucose and ketone self-testing, recognising and treating hypoglycaemia, sick-day rules (never stop basal insulin; check glucose and ketones every 2–4 hours when ill), when to come back, and specialist follow-up.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录出院前的教育和随访安排；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record his discharge education or follow-up arrangements; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 停用胰岛素，改服二甲双胍
name.en: Stop insulin and switch to metformin tablets

dose.zh-CN: 出院时停用胰岛素，改为二甲双胍口服。
dose.en: Stop insulin at discharge and start metformin tablets.

harm.zh-CN: 刚经历酮症酸中毒、糖尿病类型尚未明确时停用胰岛素，可能再次发生酮症酸中毒。ADA 2026 糖尿病诊疗标准（第 2 部分）建议对疑似 1 型糖尿病的成人检测胰岛自身抗体；能否减停胰岛素，要等分型和胰岛功能明确后由专科决定。
harm.en: Stopping insulin straight after ketoacidosis, with his diabetes type not yet known, risks another episode. The ADA Standards of Care 2026 (section 2) advise islet autoantibody testing in adults with suspected type 1 diabetes; whether insulin can ever be reduced or stopped is a specialist decision once the type and his insulin reserve are known.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录他出院时的降糖方案；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record his treatment at discharge; it does not simulate the effect.

title.zh-CN: 问清病程，检查他的呼吸、颈部和胸壁
title.en: Take his story and examine his breathing, neck and chest wall

hint.zh-CN: 一个多月的口干、消瘦和几天的呕吐，与今天的呼吸有什么联系？听诊之外，用手摸一摸颈部和胸壁，可能发现听诊器发现不了的东西吗？
hint.en: How do a month of thirst and weight loss and days of vomiting connect with how he is breathing today — and what might your hands find at his neck and chest wall that a stethoscope would miss?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问清口干、消瘦、呕吐和气促的经过，测生命体征，观察呼吸，触诊颈部、胸壁和腹壁，听诊双肺。
guidance.en: At the bedside, take the story of the thirst, weight loss, vomiting and breathlessness, check his vital signs, watch his breathing, feel the neck, chest wall and abdominal wall, and listen to both lungs.

title.zh-CN: 找出他呼吸深快的原因
title.en: Find what is driving his breathing

hint.zh-CN: 他的症状提示哪一类代谢问题？哪几项床旁和实验室检查能在几分钟内回答？读血气时，PaCO₂ 和 HCO₃⁻ 之间应当是什么关系？
hint.en: Which metabolic problem do his symptoms suggest, and which bedside and laboratory tests answer that within minutes? Reading the gas, how should the PaCO₂ relate to the bicarbonate?

guidance.zh-CN: 床旁测血糖，送尿液分析和动脉血气，阅读结果后在会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Check his blood glucose at the bedside, send a urinalysis and an arterial blood gas, read the results and answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 开始第一个小时的治疗
title.en: Start the first hour of treatment

hint.zh-CN: 开始胰岛素之前，你必须先看到哪一项结果？血钠会怎样影响你对液体的选择？他应该在哪里接受治疗？
hint.en: Which result must you have before insulin starts, and how will the sodium shape your choice of fluid? Where should he be treated?

guidance.zh-CN: 阅读电解质和肾功能，在会诊板作答决策 3，然后付诸行动：补液、胰岛素、补钾、监测计划，以及合适的治疗地点。
guidance.en: Read the electrolytes and renal function, answer decision 3 on the case board, then act on it: fluids, insulin, potassium, the monitoring plan and the right place of care.

title.zh-CN: 针对查体发现安排检查与处理
title.en: Act on what the examination found

hint.zh-CN: 如果你的手在颈部或胸壁摸到了意料之外的东西，在几天的呕吐之后，最危险的解释是什么？在排除它之前，什么是他不能有的？
hint.en: If your hands found something unexpected at his neck or chest wall, what is the most dangerous explanation after days of vomiting — and what must he not have until it is excluded?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策 2，然后执行你的计划：相应的医嘱、影像申请和会诊。
guidance.en: Answer decision 2 on the case board, then carry out your plan: the orders, the imaging request and the consultation it needs.

title.zh-CN: 解读胸部 CT 并调整处理
title.en: Read the chest CT and adjust the plan

hint.zh-CN: CT 显示了什么？单凭这一次检查，它能排除什么、不能排除什么？哪些表现会让你考虑引流或手术？
hint.en: What does the CT show — and what can one scan exclude on its own, and what not? Which features would push you towards drainage or an operation?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅胸部 CT 报告，在会诊板作答决策 4，并落实相应的处理。
guidance.en: Read the chest CT report at a records terminal, answer decision 4 on the case board and put the plan in place.

title.zh-CN: 安排停用静脉胰岛素与出院，并查阅结局
title.en: Plan the step-down and discharge, then review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 什么标准说明酮症酸中毒已经纠正？停静脉胰岛素之前，什么必须先起效？一次酮症酸中毒足以确定他是哪一型糖尿病吗？
hint.en: Which criteria show the ketoacidosis has resolved, and what must already be working before the infusion stops? Is one episode of ketoacidosis enough to tell which type of diabetes he has?

guidance.zh-CN: 申请并阅读胃镜结果，在会诊板作答决策 5，落实出院前计划；最后在病历终端查阅记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Order and read the gastroscopy, answer decision 5 and put the pre-discharge plan in place; finally read the recorded course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 他呼吸深快，每分钟 40 次，心率 120 次/分。血糖 26.3 mmol/L，尿酮 14.4 mmol/L；动脉血气 pH 7.10，PaCO₂ 10 mmHg，HCO₃⁻ 3.1 mmol/L。你怎样解读这份血气和他的呼吸？
prompt.en: He is breathing deeply and fast at 40/min, heart rate 120/min. Blood glucose 26.3 mmol/L, urine ketones 14.4 mmol/L; arterial gas pH 7.10, PaCO₂ 10 mmHg, HCO₃⁻ 3.1 mmol/L. How do you read this gas and his breathing?

need.zh-CN: 先观察他的呼吸、测生命体征，并阅读血糖、尿液分析和动脉血气。
need.en: First watch his breathing, take his vital signs, and read the glucose, the urinalysis and the arterial gas.

text.zh-CN: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒伴严重代谢性酸中毒；PaCO₂ 10 mmHg 已接近呼吸代偿的极限，深快呼吸是在代偿，并非呼吸衰竭
text.en: Diabetic ketoacidosis with severe metabolic acidosis; a PaCO₂ of 10 mmHg is close to the limit of respiratory compensation, so the deep, fast breathing is compensation, not failure

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。2024 年 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS 共识的三项标准他都符合：血糖 ≥ 11.1 mmol/L，酮体阳性（JBDS-IP 2023 也接受尿酮 ++ 及以上），pH < 7.3 且 HCO₃⁻ < 18 mmol/L。按 Winter 公式，预计 PaCO₂ = 1.5 × 3.1 + 8 ± 2，约 10.7–14.7 mmHg，他的 10 mmHg 在这个范围的最低端：他已经在尽全力过度通气，没有呼吸储备，任何让通气减少的情况（镇静、疲劳、呼吸机设置不足）都会让 pH 急剧下降。
feedback.en: Correct. He meets all three criteria of the 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS consensus: glucose ≥ 11.1 mmol/L, ketosis (JBDS-IP 2023 also accepts urine ketones ++ or more) and pH < 7.3 with bicarbonate < 18 mmol/L. Winter's formula predicts a PaCO₂ of 1.5 × 3.1 + 8 ± 2, about 10.7–14.7 mmHg; his 10 mmHg is at the very bottom, so he is already hyperventilating as hard as he can, with no respiratory reserve — anything that reduces his ventilation (sedation, exhaustion, an under-set ventilator) will drop the pH sharply.

text.zh-CN: 代谢性酸中毒合并呼吸性酸中毒：每分钟 40 次的呼吸加上胸部可能有气体，说明他的呼吸肌已经开始疲劳，需要尽快给予通气支持
text.en: Metabolic acidosis with a superimposed respiratory acidosis: breathing at 40/min with possible air in the chest means his respiratory muscles are tiring and he needs ventilatory support soon

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。呼吸性酸中毒意味着 PaCO₂ 高于这种代谢性酸中毒应有的代偿水平；他的 PaCO₂ 只有 10 mmHg，处在 Winter 公式预计范围的最低端，通气不是衰竭，而是发挥到了极致。按 BTS/ICS 2016 指南，无创通气用于高碳酸血症性呼吸衰竭，这里没有指征；真正提示疲劳的是 PaCO₂ 开始回升。
feedback.en: No. A respiratory acidosis means a PaCO₂ higher than the compensation this metabolic acidosis calls for; his is 10 mmHg, at the bottom of Winter's predicted range — his ventilation has not failed, it is working flat out. NIV is for hypercapnic respiratory failure (BTS/ICS 2016), which this is not; the warning sign of exhaustion would be a PaCO₂ that starts to climb.

text.zh-CN: 原发性呼吸性碱中毒（疼痛、焦虑或胸部积气引起过度通气），碳酸氢根降低只是肾脏对低碳酸血症的代偿
text.en: A primary respiratory alkalosis from pain, anxiety or air in the chest, with the low bicarbonate only the kidneys' compensation for the low PaCO₂

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。pH 7.10 是酸血症：原发紊乱决定 pH 的方向，代偿不会矫枉过正；而且肾脏代偿需要数天，也不可能把 HCO₃⁻ 降到 3.1 mmol/L。原发的是代谢性酸中毒，低 PaCO₂ 才是代偿。
feedback.en: No. A pH of 7.10 is acidaemia: the primary disorder sets the direction of the pH and compensation never overshoots, and renal compensation takes days and could never bring the bicarbonate down to 3.1 mmol/L. The primary disorder is a metabolic acidosis; the low PaCO₂ is the compensation.

text.zh-CN: 以休克或脓毒症导致的乳酸酸中毒为主；血糖和尿酮升高只是应激和几天没吃东西的结果，胰岛素可以先缓一缓
text.en: Mainly lactic acidosis from shock or sepsis; the raised glucose and urine ketones are only stress and a few days without food, so insulin can wait

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。几天不进食只会引起轻度酮症，血糖正常或偏低，碳酸氢根最多轻度下降，解释不了血糖 26.3 mmol/L 伴 HCO₃⁻ 3.1 mmol/L。本病例没有乳酸值：测乳酸可以补充信息，但推翻不了已经成立的酮症酸中毒三联征，按 2024 年共识这需要静脉胰岛素。
feedback.en: No. A few days without food cause only mild ketosis, with a normal or low glucose and at most a modest fall in bicarbonate — not a glucose of 26.3 mmol/L with a bicarbonate of 3.1 mmol/L. No lactate is recorded here: one would add information but cannot undo the ketoacidosis triad, which by the 2024 consensus needs intravenous insulin.

prompt.zh-CN: 近 3 天他恶心、呕吐，吐出过咖啡渣样的东西。查体：颈部、前胸壁和腹壁皮下都可触及握雪感，双肺呼吸音减低。对这些发现，你现在怎么处理？
prompt.en: For three days he has felt sick and vomited, bringing up material like coffee grounds. On examination there is crepitus under the skin of the neck, the front of the chest and the abdominal wall, and breath sounds are reduced on both sides. What do you do about these findings now?

need.zh-CN: 先问清呕吐的情况和呕吐物的样子，触诊颈部、胸壁和腹壁，并听诊双肺。
need.en: First ask about the vomiting and what came up, feel the neck, chest wall and abdominal wall, and listen to both lungs.

text.zh-CN: 立即禁食，尽快行颈胸部 CT（疑有食管破裂时加口服水溶性造影剂），并请胸外科会诊
text.en: Nil by mouth now, an urgent CT of the neck and chest (with water-soluble oral contrast if oesophageal rupture is suspected) and a thoracic surgical review

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。剧烈呕吐后颈胸部皮下出现气体，最危险的来源是自发性食管破裂（Boerhaave 综合征），漏诊会迅速进展为纵隔炎和脓毒症，所以在排除之前不能经口进入任何东西。WSES 2019 食管急症指南把 CT（结合口服造影剂）作为疑似食管穿孔的首选检查，CT 同时能显示纵隔气肿、气胸和胸腔积液。酮症酸中毒的治疗不必等影像，两条线同时推进。
feedback.en: Correct. After forceful vomiting, the most dangerous source of air in the neck and chest is a spontaneous oesophageal rupture (Boerhaave syndrome), which turns quickly into mediastinitis and sepsis if missed, so nothing goes by mouth until it is excluded. The WSES 2019 guidelines on oesophageal emergencies make CT with oral contrast the first investigation for suspected perforation, and the same scan shows any pneumomediastinum, pneumothorax or effusion. The ketoacidosis treatment does not wait for the scan: both run in parallel.

text.zh-CN: 深快呼吸导致肺泡破裂就能解释这些积气：先只治疗酮症酸中毒，暂不做影像检查，观察握雪感是否扩大，扩大了再拍胸片
text.en: Alveolar rupture from the deep, fast breathing explains this air: treat the ketoacidosis alone, hold off imaging, watch whether the crepitus spreads and get a chest film only if it does

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。强力呼吸使肺泡破裂、气体沿支气管血管鞘进入纵隔（Macklin 效应）确实是常见机制，但它是排除性诊断，不能在床旁直接认定。他有呕吐和咖啡渣样呕吐物，必须先用影像排除食管破裂和气胸；等握雪感扩大再检查，可能错过处理穿孔的最佳时机。
feedback.en: No. Alveolar rupture from forceful breathing, with air tracking along the bronchovascular sheaths into the mediastinum (the Macklin effect), is a common mechanism, but it is a diagnosis of exclusion, not one to make at the bedside. With vomiting and coffee-ground vomit, a ruptured oesophagus and a pneumothorax must be excluded by imaging first; waiting for the crepitus to spread can cost the window for treating a perforation.

text.zh-CN: 先做急诊胃镜：直接寻找食管裂口和咖啡渣样呕吐物的出血来源，顺便止血，再根据胃镜所见决定要不要做 CT
text.en: Urgent gastroscopy first, to look directly for an oesophageal tear and the source of the coffee-ground vomit and stop any bleeding, then decide from its findings whether a CT is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。怀疑食管穿孔时，内镜下注气可能使裂口扩大、把更多气体压入纵隔，所以先做 CT；确实需要内镜时，放在 CT 之后，由有经验的医生操作，并尽量用二氧化碳注气。咖啡渣样呕吐物的出血来源可以稍后评估，它不改变先排除穿孔的顺序。
feedback.en: No. If the oesophagus may be perforated, insufflation at endoscopy can widen the tear and push more air into the mediastinum, so CT comes first; if endoscopy is needed it follows the CT, done by an experienced endoscopist and preferably with CO₂ insufflation. The source of the coffee-ground vomit can be assessed later; it does not change the order — perforation is excluded first.

text.zh-CN: 双肺呼吸音减低说明双侧气胸：不等影像，立即在两侧放置胸腔闭式引流管，然后再处理酮症酸中毒
text.en: Reduced breath sounds on both sides mean bilateral pneumothoraces: put in chest drains on both sides now, without waiting for imaging, and then treat the ketoacidosis

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。胸壁皮下大量积气本身就会让呼吸音变低，双侧对称减低并不能证明双侧气胸；本病例也没有记录低血压、气管移位等张力性气胸的表现。没有影像证实就双侧置管，会带来出血、器官损伤和感染的风险：先影像，再决定；只有出现张力性气胸的表现时才需要立即减压。
feedback.en: No. Air in the chest wall muffles breath sounds by itself, and symmetrically reduced sounds do not prove two pneumothoraces; no hypotension or tracheal shift — the signs of tension — is recorded here. Drains on both sides without imaging add bleeding, organ injury and infection: image first, and decompress at once only if signs of tension appear.

prompt.zh-CN: 你已判断他是糖尿病酮症酸中毒（pH 7.10，HCO₃⁻ 3.1 mmol/L）。电解质：钠 112 mmol/L，钾 3.8 mmol/L，肌酐 217 µmol/L；心率 120 次/分。第一个小时怎么处理？
prompt.en: You have diagnosed diabetic ketoacidosis (pH 7.10, HCO₃⁻ 3.1 mmol/L). Electrolytes: sodium 112 mmol/L, potassium 3.8 mmol/L, creatinine 217 µmol/L; heart rate 120/min. What is your plan for the first hour?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 1，并阅读电解质和肾功能结果。
need.en: First answer decision 1 and read the electrolytes and renal function.

text.zh-CN: 等渗液补液，固定速率静脉胰岛素 0.1 单位/(kg·h)，从一开始就在补液中加钾；每小时复查血糖、血酮和校正钠，转入高依赖病房
text.en: Isotonic fluid, a fixed-rate insulin infusion of 0.1 units/kg/h and potassium in the fluids from the start, with hourly glucose, ketones and corrected sodium in a high-dependency bed

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。2024 年共识与 JBDS-IP 2023 一致：等渗液开始补液，固定速率胰岛素 0.1 单位/(kg·h)；血钾 3.5–5.5 mmol/L 时每升液体加钾（JBDS 为 40 mmol/L），因为胰岛素一起效血钾就会快速下降。HCO₃⁻ < 5 mmol/L 和心率 > 100 次/分都是 JBDS 需要 2 级（HDU）监护的指标。血钠 112 mmol/L 经血糖校正后约 118–121 mmol/L，仍是严重的真性低钠，他又正好 25 岁（JBDS 提醒 18–25 岁者脑水肿风险较高），所以补液要稳，并监测血钠和神经系统体征。
feedback.en: Correct. The 2024 consensus and JBDS-IP 2023 agree: isotonic fluid first and a fixed-rate infusion at 0.1 units/kg/h; with potassium 3.5–5.5 mmol/L it goes into each litre (40 mmol/L in JBDS), because it falls fast once insulin acts. A bicarbonate below 5 mmol/L and a pulse above 100/min are both JBDS markers for level-2 (HDU) care. His sodium of 112 mmol/L corrects to about 118–121 mmol/L for the glucose — still a severe true hyponatraemia — and at 25 he is in the age band JBDS flags for cerebral oedema, so replace fluid steadily and watch the sodium and his neurology.

text.zh-CN: 先静脉滴注碳酸氢钠，把 pH 提到 7.2 以上再开始胰岛素，避免严重酸中毒抑制心肌、诱发心律失常；同时等渗液补液并心电监护
text.en: Sodium bicarbonate first, to bring the pH above 7.2 before insulin starts so the acidosis does not depress the heart or trigger arrhythmia; isotonic fluid meanwhile, with ECG monitoring

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。2024 年共识只在 pH < 7.0 时考虑碳酸氢钠，他的 pH 是 7.10。碳酸氢钠不能加快恢复，却会在胰岛素起效后加重低钾（他的钾只有 3.8 mmol/L）、增加钠负荷，并可能延缓酮体清除；推迟胰岛素只会让酮症酸中毒持续更久。
feedback.en: No. The 2024 consensus considers bicarbonate only below pH 7.0; his is 7.10. It does not speed recovery, but once insulin acts it deepens hypokalaemia — his potassium is only 3.8 mmol/L — adds a sodium load and may slow ketone clearance, and holding insulin back only prolongs the ketoacidosis.

text.zh-CN: 0.9% 氯化钠快速补液，同时开始固定速率胰岛素；钾 3.8 mmol/L 在正常范围，先不补，等复查降到 3.5 mmol/L 以下再补，以免高钾
text.en: 0.9 % sodium chloride run fast with a fixed-rate insulin infusion; potassium 3.8 mmol/L is within the normal range, so leave it out and add it only if a repeat falls below 3.5 mmol/L, to avoid hyperkalaemia

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。酮症酸中毒时全身的钾是缺失的，3.8 mmol/L 只是酸中毒把钾移出细胞的结果，胰岛素和补液会让它迅速下降。JBDS-IP 2023 在血钾 3.5–5.5 mmol/L 时就在每升液体中加钾；等低于 3.5 再补，会在治疗途中遇到危险的低钾。
feedback.en: No. Total-body potassium is depleted in DKA; 3.8 mmol/L reflects potassium shifted out of the cells by the acidosis, and insulin and fluid will bring it down fast. JBDS-IP 2023 adds potassium to every litre while it is 3.5–5.5 mmol/L; waiting for it to fall below 3.5 meets dangerous hypokalaemia midway through treatment.

text.zh-CN: 血糖这么高，血浆一定是高渗的：用 0.45% 氯化钠快速补液，同时开始胰岛素，以免进一步加重高渗和脱水
text.en: With a glucose this high his plasma must be hyperosmolar: run 0.45 % sodium chloride fast and start insulin, so as not to worsen the hyperosmolar state and the dehydration

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他的有效渗透压（2 × Na⁺ + 葡萄糖）约为 2 × 112 + 26.3 ≈ 250 mOsm/kg，是低渗而不是高渗。低渗液会把血钠和渗透压拉得更低，增加脑水肿的风险：起始用等渗液（2024 年共识），并在用血糖校正血钠之后再判断（2014 年欧洲低钠血症指南）。
feedback.en: No. His effective osmolality (2 × Na⁺ + glucose) is about 2 × 112 + 26.3 ≈ 250 mOsm/kg — hypotonic, not hyperosmolar. A hypotonic fluid would push the sodium and osmolality lower still and raise the risk of cerebral oedema: start with isotonic fluid (2024 consensus), and judge the sodium only after correcting it for the glucose (European hyponatraemia guideline 2014).

prompt.zh-CN: 胸部 CT 报告：纵隔积气及皮下积气，食管扩张，未见明确的食管或气管撕裂口。酮症酸中毒正在治疗中。接下来怎么处理这些积气？
prompt.en: The chest CT report: air in the mediastinum and under the skin, a dilated oesophagus, and no definite oesophageal or tracheal tear. His ketoacidosis is being treated. How do you manage the air now?

need.zh-CN: 先在本阶段调阅胸部 CT 报告。
need.en: First read the chest CT report in this stage.

text.zh-CN: 最可能是自发性纵隔气肿：继续禁食并胃肠减压，继续治疗酮症酸中毒，观察气道；出现胸痛、发热或积液时复查影像
text.en: Spontaneous pneumomediastinum is likeliest: stay nil by mouth with gastric decompression, continue the DKA treatment, watch his airway, and re-image if pain, fever or an effusion appears

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。CT 显示纵隔气肿但没有看到裂口，最可能的机制是呕吐和深快呼吸使肺泡破裂，气体沿支气管血管鞘进入纵隔、再到皮下，以治疗诱因和观察为主。但一次 CT 没看到裂口并不能百分之百排除小的食管穿孔（WSES 2019），所以禁食、胃肠减压和外科随访要持续到临床上确实安全为止。报告也记录了胃肠减压。
feedback.en: Correct. The CT shows a pneumomediastinum without a visible tear; the likeliest mechanism is alveolar rupture from vomiting and forceful breathing, with air tracking along the bronchovascular sheaths into the mediastinum and on under the skin, which is managed by treating the cause and observing. But one CT without a tear does not exclude a small oesophageal perforation with certainty (WSES 2019), so nil by mouth, decompression and surgical follow-up continue until he is clinically safe. The report also records gastric decompression.

text.zh-CN: 食管扩张加上咖啡渣样呕吐物，已足以诊断自发性食管破裂：今天就急诊开胸探查修补，同时使用广谱抗生素和抗真菌药
text.en: A dilated oesophagus with coffee-ground vomit is enough to diagnose spontaneous oesophageal rupture: explore and repair through a thoracotomy today, with broad-spectrum antibiotics and antifungals

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。食管扩张可由呕吐、动力异常或吞入空气引起，本身不是穿孔的证据；咖啡渣样物提示上消化道少量出血，也证明不了破裂。CT 没有看到裂口，也没有记录胸腔积液，此时开胸是把一个通常可以保守处理的问题变成大手术。
feedback.en: No. A dilated oesophagus can follow vomiting, dysmotility or swallowed air and is not itself evidence of perforation, and coffee-ground material points to minor upper GI bleeding, not rupture. With no tear on CT and no effusion recorded, a thoracotomy now would turn a condition usually managed conservatively into major surgery.

text.zh-CN: CT 没有看到撕裂口，就可以排除食管穿孔：今天恢复经口进食和口服补液，停止胃肠减压，只按单纯的酮症酸中毒继续治疗
text.en: No tear on CT rules oesophageal perforation out: restart food and oral fluids today, stop the gastric decompression and carry on treating an uncomplicated ketoacidosis

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。一次 CT 没看到裂口降低了穿孔的可能，但不能完全排除；过早经口进食，一旦遇上漏诊的小穿孔，可能引起纵隔炎。应在临床稳定、外科评估同意后再逐步恢复经口进食。
feedback.en: No. A CT without a visible tear makes perforation less likely but cannot exclude it completely, and early feeding over a missed small perforation can cause mediastinitis. Restart oral intake step by step once he is clinically stable and the surgeons agree.

text.zh-CN: 给予 CPAP 或无创正压通气：用正压把肺撑开，减少继续漏气，并帮助纵隔和皮下的气体更快吸收
text.en: Start CPAP or non-invasive ventilation to splint the lungs open with positive pressure, stop further air leaking and help the air in the mediastinum and under the skin resorb faster

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。正压通气会提高气道和肺泡内的压力，可能加重漏气、使纵隔和皮下积气扩大，甚至诱发张力性气胸；他也没有高碳酸血症性呼吸衰竭，不符合 BTS/ICS 2016 的无创通气指征。去除诱因后，积气通常会自行吸收。
feedback.en: No. Positive pressure raises airway and alveolar pressure and can enlarge the leak, spread the air in the mediastinum and under the skin, and even cause a tension pneumothorax; nor does he have the hypercapnic respiratory failure NIV treats (BTS/ICS 2016). Once the cause is treated, the air usually resorbs on its own.

text.zh-CN: 积气已经到了颈部：常规做颈部皮肤切开或放置皮下引流，把气体放出来，防止压迫气道——这类患者都应这样处理
text.en: The air has reached his neck: make routine cervical skin incisions or place subcutaneous drains to let it out before it compresses the airway — every patient like this should have it

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，至少不应作为常规。颈部切开或皮下引流用于积气已危及气道、发声、吞咽、呼吸或循环的少数患者；没有这些表现时，多数自发性纵隔气肿在去除诱因后会自行吸收。报告中的团队为他做了颈部引流，本病例没有记录当时的指征。
feedback.en: No — at least not routinely. Cervical incisions or subcutaneous drains are for the few patients whose air threatens the airway, voice, swallowing, breathing or circulation; without those, most spontaneous pneumomediastinum resorbs once the cause is treated. The report's team did drain his neck; this case does not record why.

prompt.zh-CN: 住院后期的胃镜：见咖啡渣样物和十二指肠充血，未发现明显的食管或胃壁穿孔。为他停用静脉胰岛素和出院做计划，应包括哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: Later in the admission, gastroscopy shows coffee-ground material and duodenal congestion, with no obvious perforation of the oesophagus or stomach wall. What should the plan for coming off the insulin infusion and for discharge include? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 4，并在本阶段申请、阅读胃镜结果。
need.en: First answer decision 4, then order and read the gastroscopy in this stage.

text.zh-CN: 酮症酸中毒纠正（血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L，且 pH ≥ 7.3 或 HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18 mmol/L）、能进食后，先皮下注射基础胰岛素，1–2 小时后再停静脉胰岛素
text.en: Once the ketoacidosis has resolved (ketones < 0.6 mmol/L with pH ≥ 7.3 or bicarbonate ≥ 18 mmol/L) and he can eat, give subcutaneous basal insulin and stop the infusion 1–2 hours later

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。2024 年共识以血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L 且静脉 pH ≥ 7.3 或 HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18 mmol/L 作为纠正标准，要求停静脉胰岛素前至少 1–2 小时皮下给予基础胰岛素；静脉胰岛素的作用几分钟内就会消失，没有重叠，酮症酸中毒容易反跳。本病例没有记录他实际的过渡方案。
feedback.en: Include. The 2024 consensus defines resolution as ketones < 0.6 mmol/L with venous pH ≥ 7.3 or bicarbonate ≥ 18 mmol/L and gives subcutaneous basal insulin at least 1–2 hours before the infusion stops; intravenous insulin wears off within minutes, and without an overlap ketoacidosis can rebound. This case does not record his actual transition.

text.zh-CN: 不凭这一次发作给他定型：检测胰岛自身抗体（必要时加 C 肽），由内分泌科随访明确糖尿病类型
text.en: Do not assign his diabetes type from this episode alone: test islet autoantibodies (with C-peptide where needed) and have endocrinology follow him up to settle the type

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。年轻、消瘦、以酮症酸中毒起病提示 1 型糖尿病，但酮症倾向的 2 型糖尿病也可以这样起病。ADA 2026 糖尿病诊疗标准（第 2 部分）建议对疑似 1 型糖尿病的成人检测胰岛自身抗体，C 肽在急性期过后再测更可靠。本病例没有记录他的抗体、C 肽或最终分型。
feedback.en: Include. Youth, weight loss and a ketoacidotic onset point to type 1 diabetes, but ketosis-prone type 2 diabetes can begin the same way. The ADA Standards of Care 2026 (section 2) advise islet autoantibody testing in adults with suspected type 1 diabetes, and C-peptide is more informative once the acute illness has passed. This case records no antibodies, C-peptide or final type.

text.zh-CN: 出院前完成糖尿病教育：胰岛素注射、血糖和血酮自测、低血糖处理、生病时不停基础胰岛素，以及什么情况下要返院
text.en: Diabetes education before he leaves: insulin injections, glucose and ketone self-testing, managing hypoglycaemia, never stopping basal insulin when ill, and when to come back

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。这是新诊断的糖尿病，而且以酮症酸中毒起病；JBDS-IP 2023 和 2024 年共识都强调出院前的结构化教育和生病期间规则（不停基础胰岛素、勤测血糖和血酮），这是预防再次发作的关键。
feedback.en: Include. This is newly diagnosed diabetes that presented in ketoacidosis; JBDS-IP 2023 and the 2024 consensus both stress structured education and sick-day rules before discharge — keep the basal insulin going and test glucose and ketones often — as the main defence against another episode.

text.zh-CN: 成年人最常见的是 2 型糖尿病：出院前停用胰岛素，改为二甲双胍口服，门诊再根据血糖决定是否重新使用胰岛素
text.en: Type 2 diabetes is the commonest kind in adults: stop insulin before discharge, switch to metformin tablets and decide in clinic whether he needs insulin again

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。刚经历严重酮症酸中毒、类型未明时停用胰岛素，有再次发生酮症酸中毒的风险；即使最终证实是酮症倾向的 2 型糖尿病，减停胰岛素也应在专科随访下进行（ADA 2026 糖尿病诊疗标准）。
feedback.en: Leave out. Stopping insulin in someone just out of severe ketoacidosis, with the type unknown, risks another episode; even if ketosis-prone type 2 diabetes is confirmed, any step-down from insulin happens under specialist follow-up (ADA Standards of Care 2026).

text.zh-CN: 只按血糖读数注射短效胰岛素的纠正剂量，不用基础胰岛素，等血糖稳定后再决定长期方案
text.en: Rapid-acting insulin correction doses by the glucose reading only, without basal insulin, until his glucose settles and a long-term plan can be made

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。ADA 2026 糖尿病诊疗标准（院内糖尿病管理部分）不主张单用纠正剂量胰岛素（“滑动量表”）；对缺乏胰岛素的患者，没有基础胰岛素，两次注射之间酮症就会卷土重来。
feedback.en: Leave out. The ADA Standards of Care 2026 (diabetes care in the hospital) discourage correction ('sliding-scale') insulin on its own; in an insulin-deficient patient, without basal insulin ketosis returns between doses.

text.zh-CN: 问清口干多饮的时长、一个月内的体重下降、呕吐及呕吐物性状、气促起始，以及既往糖尿病史和药物过敏
text.en: Established how long the thirst had lasted, the weight lost in a month, the vomiting and what came up, when the breathlessness began, and asked about previous diabetes and drug allergies

text.zh-CN: 测量生命体征，观察呼吸方式，触诊颈部、胸壁和腹壁，并听诊双肺
text.en: Took the vital signs, watched the breathing pattern, felt the neck, chest wall and abdominal wall, and listened to both lungs

text.zh-CN: 在急诊阅读血糖、尿液分析、动脉血气和电解质，并申请心电图
text.en: In the ED, read the glucose, urinalysis, arterial gas and electrolytes, and asked for an ECG

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断为糖尿病酮症酸中毒，并认出深快呼吸是接近极限的呼吸代偿
text.en: Recognised diabetic ketoacidosis at the first attempt, with the deep breathing as near-maximal respiratory compensation

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对第一个小时的方案，并下达强化监测计划、联系高依赖病房
text.en: Chose the first-hour plan at the first attempt, set the intensive monitoring plan and called for a high-dependency bed

text.zh-CN: 在急诊开始等渗液补液，并在看到血钾之后开始固定速率胰岛素和补钾
text.en: In the ED, started isotonic fluid, and started the fixed-rate insulin and the potassium only once the potassium result was known

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把呕吐后的皮下积气按可能的食管破裂处理，并请胸外科会诊
text.en: At the first attempt, treated the air under the skin after vomiting as a possible oesophageal rupture, and asked thoracic surgery to review

text.zh-CN: 在急诊就让他禁食禁水并申请胸部 CT，在结果出来之前先排查食管破裂
text.en: In the ED, kept him nil by mouth and requested the chest CT — investigating oesophageal rupture before any result was back

text.zh-CN: 阅读胸部 CT 报告，首次作答即选择保守处理并继续观察，没有把一次阴性 CT 当作穿孔已排除
text.en: Read the chest CT report and chose conservative care with surveillance at the first attempt, without treating one negative scan as proof that there was no perforation

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制订出院前计划，并安排皮下基础胰岛素和糖尿病教育
text.en: Set the pre-discharge plan at the first attempt and arranged subcutaneous basal insulin and diabetes education

text.zh-CN: 没有给碳酸氢钠、低渗盐水或无创正压通气，出院时也没有停用胰岛素改服二甲双胍
text.en: Gave no bicarbonate, hypotonic saline or non-invasive ventilation, and did not swap his insulin for metformin at discharge

text.zh-CN: 向他解释病情、治疗和禁食的理由，回应他的担心，并在出院前谈清新诊断的糖尿病
text.en: Explained his condition, the treatment and why he must not eat or drink, answered his worry, and talked through his new diabetes before discharge

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、收集信息、解释与计划、结束）：自我介绍，照顾到他说话费力，用简短的封闭式问题收集关键病史；用通俗的话说明他的血糖很高、身体在“产酸”，所以呼吸又深又快，需要输液、静脉胰岛素和补钾，并在能持续监护的地方接受治疗；解释脖子和胸口皮下有气，需要先做 CT、暂时不能吃喝，并说明原因；坦诚回应他“是不是得了大病”的担心，不作虚假保证，也不预告病例没有记录的结局；确认他听懂了，告诉他接下来会发生什么。出院前：说明这是新诊断的糖尿病、需要胰岛素、分型要等抗体等检查，教会生病期间规则和何时返院。不编造病例中没有的检查结果。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering information, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves and, because talking tires him, gathers the key history with short closed questions; explains in plain words that his blood sugar is very high and his body is making acid, which is why he is breathing so deeply and fast, and that he needs a drip, insulin into the vein, potassium and a closely monitored bed; explains that there is air under the skin of his neck and chest, that a CT comes first and that he must not eat or drink for now, and why; answers his worry that it is something serious honestly, without false reassurance or predictions the case does not record; checks understanding and says what happens next. Before discharge: explains that this is newly found diabetes that needs insulin, that the type depends on tests such as antibodies, and teaches sick-day rules and when to come back. Invents no result the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 到院交班（ISBAR）：25 岁男性，口干多饮一个多月，近 3 天乏力、恶心呕吐，昨天起明显气促，现已在急诊抢救区；分诊时心率 120 次/分，呼吸 40 次/分，其余生命体征没有可报告的记录。抢救区床旁有监护仪、抢救车（留置针、常用药）、输液泵、心电图机、氧气、吸引器和呼吸机；血糖仪在急诊护士站；血气、生化、尿液和血常规送检验科；做 CT 和胃镜要把患者送到 CT 室和内镜室；急诊护士站有病历终端。复述医嘱，完成护理范围内的操作（禁食、胃管、液体和输液泵）；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到血压、体温、血氧或其他没有记录的数值时，如实说没有可报的记录，绝不报出数字。
knowledge.en: Handover on arrival (ISBAR): 25-year-old man, over a month of thirst and heavy drinking, three days of weakness, nausea and vomiting, badly breathless since yesterday, now in the ED resus area; at triage heart rate 120/min and respiratory rate 40/min, with no other observation on record to report. At the resus bedside: a monitor, the crash cart (cannulas, common drugs), infusion pumps, the ECG machine, oxygen, suction and a ventilator; the glucose meter is at the ED nurse station; blood gas, chemistry, urine and blood counts go to the laboratory; CT and gastroscopy mean taking him to the CT suite or the endoscopy suite; records terminal at the ED nurse station. Reads orders back and does nursing-scope tasks (nil by mouth, a nasogastric tube, fluids and pumps); reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for a blood pressure, temperature, saturation or any other value that is not on record, says so plainly — never gives a number.

name.zh-CN: 龙医生（急诊科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“他的呼吸是在帮他还是在害他？”“按 Winter 公式，这个 HCO₃⁻ 对应的 PaCO₂ 应该是多少？”“开胰岛素之前你要先看到哪个结果？”“钾 3.8 在这种酸中毒里算安全吗？胰岛素起效后会怎样？”“钠和血糖一起看，他是高渗还是低渗？”“呕吐几天后颈部有握雪感，最不能漏的是什么？哪项检查先做？”“CT 没看到裂口，能完全放心吗？”“什么情况下才需要颈部引流？”“停静脉胰岛素前要先做什么？”。可以讲解 2024 年 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS 共识、JBDS-IP 2023、2014 年欧洲低钠血症指南、WSES 2019 食管急症指南和 BTS/ICS 2016 无创通气指南的相关原则；学员读到相应记录后，可以对照记录的处理（补液、胰岛素、胃肠减压、颈部引流）与现行做法。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的资料（血压、体温、血氧、意识状态、体重、氯和阴离子间隙、血酮、血红蛋白、胸片、治疗方案和剂量、引流指征都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “Is his breathing helping him or harming him?”, “By Winter's formula, what PaCO₂ goes with this bicarbonate?”, “Which result must you see before insulin starts?”, “Is a potassium of 3.8 safe in acidosis like this — what happens once insulin acts?”, “Reading the sodium with the glucose, is he hyperosmolar or hypotonic?”, “Crepitus in the neck after days of vomiting — what must not be missed, and which test comes first?”, “No tear on CT — can you relax completely?”, “When would the neck need draining?”, “What must be on board before the insulin infusion stops?”. May explain the relevant principles of the 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS consensus, JBDS-IP 2023, the 2014 European hyponatraemia guideline, the WSES 2019 oesophageal emergency guidelines and the BTS/ICS 2016 NIV guideline, and — once the learner has read the records — contrast the recorded management (fluids, insulin, gastric decompression, cervical drainage) with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (blood pressure, temperature, saturation, conscious level, weight, chloride and anion gap, blood ketones, haemoglobin, chest film, treatment regimens and doses, and the reason for drainage are not recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 内分泌科医生，只解读学员已经读过的血糖、尿液分析、血气和电解质：酮症酸中毒的诊断标准和分级、Winter 公式、补钾的阈值、校正血钠和有效渗透压的算法、液体选择、18–25 岁患者的脑水肿风险、纠正标准与皮下胰岛素过渡、糖尿病分型（胰岛自身抗体，急性期后再测 C 肽）和出院教育。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造血酮、氯、渗透压、糖化血红蛋白、C 肽、抗体或最终分型（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Endocrinologist who interprets only the glucose, urinalysis, blood gas and electrolytes the learner has read: the diagnostic criteria and grading of ketoacidosis, Winter's formula, the potassium thresholds, how to correct the sodium and calculate the effective osmolality, fluid choice, the cerebral-oedema caution at age 18–25, resolution criteria and the move to subcutaneous insulin, classification (islet autoantibodies, C-peptide once the acute illness has passed) and discharge education. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents a ketone, chloride, osmolality, HbA1c, C-peptide or antibody value or a final diabetes type (none is recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 胸外科医生，接到会诊后参与。只解读学员已经读过的胸部 CT 报告和胃镜结果：纵隔气肿的 Macklin 机制，与自发性食管破裂的鉴别，一次没有裂口的 CT 能排除和不能排除什么，为什么先 CT 后胃镜、胃镜时为什么用二氧化碳注气，什么情况下需要颈部引流或手术（积气危及气道、呼吸或循环，或证实穿孔并污染）。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造造影剂使用、气胸、胸腔积液、胃镜时间、出血来源或引流指征（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Thoracic surgeon who joins once asked to review. Interprets only the chest CT report and gastroscopy result the learner has read: the Macklin mechanism of pneumomediastinum, how to tell it from spontaneous oesophageal rupture, what one CT without a tear does and does not exclude, why CT comes before endoscopy and why CO₂ is used for insufflation, and when the neck needs draining or an operation is needed (air threatening the airway, breathing or circulation, or a proven perforation with contamination). Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents contrast use, a pneumothorax, an effusion, the timing of the gastroscopy, the bleeding source or the reason for drainage (none is recorded).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：呕吐后的深快呼吸与颈胸部握雪感
title.en: Debrief: deep, fast breathing and crepitus at the neck after days of vomiting

conclusion.zh-CN: 25岁男性，既往无糖尿病，诊断为糖尿病酮症酸中毒合并自发性纵隔气肿和皮下气肿。口干多饮一个多月，一个月内体重下降约 10 kg，近 3 天乏力、恶心、呕吐咖啡渣样物，入院前 1 天明显气促；心率 120 次/分，呼吸深快 40 次/分，颈部、胸壁和腹壁有握雪感，双肺呼吸音低。血糖 26.3 mmol/L、尿酮 14.4 mmol/L、pH 7.10、HCO₃⁻ 3.1 mmol/L（重度）、PaCO₂ 10 mmHg——呼吸代偿已到极限；钠 112 mmol/L（校正后约 118–121 mmol/L），钾 3.8 mmol/L，肌酐 217 µmol/L。CT 示纵隔及皮下积气，未见明确撕裂；之后的胃镜未见明显穿孔。经补液、胰岛素、胃肠减压和颈部引流后好转，积气约 1 周基本吸收，住院约 2 周出院，随访 2 年未复发。现行做法：在高依赖病房等渗补液、固定速率胰岛素并尽早补钾，不用碳酸氢钠；禁食，先 CT 后胃镜；引流只用于积气危及气道、呼吸或循环时。
conclusion.en: Diabetic ketoacidosis with spontaneous pneumomediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema in a 25-year-old new to diabetes: over a month of thirst, about 10 kg lost in a month, three days of weakness, nausea and coffee-ground vomiting, a day of marked breathlessness. Pulse 120/min, deep breathing at 40/min, crepitus from neck to abdominal wall, reduced breath sounds. Glucose 26.3 mmol/L, urine ketones 14.4 mmol/L, pH 7.10, bicarbonate 3.1 mmol/L (severe), PaCO₂ 10 mmHg (maximal compensation); sodium 112 mmol/L (118–121 corrected), potassium 3.8 mmol/L, creatinine 217 µmol/L. CT: mediastinal and subcutaneous air, no definite tear; later gastroscopy: no obvious perforation. He improved with fluids, insulin, gastric decompression and cervical drainage: air largely cleared in a week, home at about two weeks, no recurrence in two years. Today: isotonic fluid, fixed-rate insulin and early potassium in an HDU bed, no bicarbonate; nil by mouth, CT before endoscopy, drainage for compromise only.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 口干多饮、一个月消瘦约 10 kg、呕吐和气促出现在一位既往无糖尿病的年轻人身上：首先想到新发糖尿病合并酮症酸中毒，床旁立即测血糖和酮体。
keyReasoning.en: Thirst, about 10 kg lost in a month, vomiting and breathlessness in a young man with no known diabetes: think of new diabetes in ketoacidosis, and check glucose and ketones at the bedside at once.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 读血气先看 pH 的方向：pH 7.10 是酸血症，HCO₃⁻ 3.1 mmol/L 是原发改变；PaCO₂ 10 mmHg 处在 Winter 公式预计值的最低端，深快呼吸是最大限度的代偿，而不是呼吸衰竭。
keyReasoning.en: Read the gas from the pH: 7.10 is acidaemia and a bicarbonate of 3.1 mmol/L is the primary change; a PaCO₂ of 10 mmHg at the bottom of Winter's range makes the deep breathing maximal compensation, not respiratory failure.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 颈部、胸壁和腹壁的握雪感说明有气体从胸腔内漏出；结合几天的呕吐和咖啡渣样呕吐物，在影像排除食管破裂之前，什么都不能经口进入。
keyReasoning.en: Crepitus at the neck, chest wall and abdominal wall means air is escaping from inside the chest; with days of vomiting and coffee-ground material, nothing goes by mouth until imaging has excluded oesophageal rupture.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 在严重酸中毒时，钾 3.8 mmol/L 并不让人放心：胰岛素一起效就会下降，所以从一开始补钾；钠 112 mmol/L 用血糖校正后仍约 118–121 mmol/L，是真性低钠，决定了只能用等渗液。
keyReasoning.en: A potassium of 3.8 mmol/L is not reassuring in severe acidosis — insulin will drive it down, so replace it from the start; a sodium of 112 mmol/L is still about 118–121 after glucose correction, a true hyponatraemia that rules out hypotonic fluid.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: CT 显示纵隔积气但没有裂口：最可能是呕吐和深快呼吸引起的肺泡破裂；保守处理并继续观察，因为一次阴性的 CT 不能完全排除小的穿孔。
keyReasoning.en: A CT with mediastinal air but no tear points to alveolar rupture from vomiting and forceful breathing; manage conservatively and keep watching, because one negative CT cannot fully exclude a small perforation.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告；本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明纵隔气肿与酮症酸中毒之间因果关系的强弱，也不能证明颈部引流或胃肠减压是他好转的原因。本病例没有记录血压、体温、血氧、意识状态、体重、完整的化验以及治疗方案和剂量；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show how strongly the ketoacidosis caused the pneumomediastinum, or that cervical drainage or gastric decompression is why he improved. No blood pressure, temperature, saturation, conscious level, weight, full laboratory work or treatment regimens and doses are recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 到院时的血压、体温、经皮血氧饱和度和意识状态（GCS），以及他的体重。
unknowns.en: His blood pressure, temperature, oxygen saturation and conscious level (GCS) on arrival, and his weight.

unknowns.zh-CN: 其余化验：血 β-羟丁酸、氯（阴离子间隙）、尿素和血浆渗透压、乳酸、血常规（血红蛋白）、淀粉酶或脂肪酶，以及治疗期间的任何复查值。
unknowns.en: The rest of the laboratory picture: blood β-hydroxybutyrate, chloride (anion gap), urea and osmolality, lactate, full blood count (haemoglobin), amylase or lipase, and any repeat value during treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: 尿酮 14.4 mmol/L 的检测方法（试纸还是定量测定），以及血糖的采样方式。
unknowns.en: How the urine ketones of 14.4 mmol/L were measured (strip or quantitative assay), and how the glucose was sampled.

unknowns.zh-CN: 胸片和心电图；CT 的扫描时间、是否用造影剂、有无气胸或胸腔积液；胃镜的时间和出血来源。
unknowns.en: Any chest X-ray or ECG; when the CT was done, whether it used contrast and whether it showed a pneumothorax or effusion; when the gastroscopy was done and the source of bleeding.

unknowns.zh-CN: 治疗细节：液体种类和量、胰岛素方案、补钾、是否用过碱剂，以及颈部引流的时间、方法和指征。
unknowns.en: Treatment details: fluid type and volumes, the insulin regimen, potassium, whether alkali was given, and the timing, method and indication of the cervical drainage.

unknowns.zh-CN: 糖尿病分型的依据（胰岛自身抗体、C 肽、HbA1c）、出院时的降糖方案和随访内容。
unknowns.en: The basis for classifying his diabetes (islet autoantibodies, C-peptide, HbA1c), his treatment at discharge and what follow-up involved.

unknowns.zh-CN: 胸痛、吞咽痛、发热、多尿等症状，以及用药、过敏、家族史、吸烟饮酒和其他物质使用情况。
unknowns.en: Symptoms such as chest pain, painful swallowing, fever or polyuria, and his medicines, allergies, family history, smoking, alcohol and other substance use.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 诊断与分级。2024 年 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS 共识：血糖 ≥ 11.1 mmol/L（或已知糖尿病）、酮体阳性（β-羟丁酸 ≥ 3.0 mmol/L；JBDS-IP 2023 也接受尿酮 ++ 及以上）、pH < 7.3 和/或 HCO₃⁻ < 18 mmol/L。按 pH 他在中度区间（7.0–7.25），按 HCO₃⁻ 在重度区间（< 10 mmol/L）；而 JBDS-IP 2023 把 HCO₃⁻ < 5 mmol/L 和心率 > 100 次/分列为需要 2 级（HDU）监护的指标，他两项都有。报告与现行做法：本病例既没有记录他在哪里接受治疗，也没有血酮数值。
teachingPoints.en: Diagnose and grade. The 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS consensus: glucose ≥ 11.1 mmol/L (or known diabetes), ketosis (β-hydroxybutyrate ≥ 3.0 mmol/L; JBDS-IP 2023 also accepts urine ketones ++ or more) and pH < 7.3 and/or bicarbonate < 18 mmol/L. His pH sits in the moderate band (7.0–7.25) and his bicarbonate in the severe band (< 10 mmol/L), and JBDS-IP 2023 lists a bicarbonate below 5 mmol/L and a pulse above 100/min — he has both — as markers for level-2 (HDU) care. Then and now: this case records neither where he was treated nor any blood ketone value.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 保护代偿。Winter 公式（预计 PaCO₂ = 1.5 × HCO₃⁻ + 8 ± 2）给出约 10.7–14.7 mmHg，他的 10 mmHg 已到极限。无创通气用于高碳酸血症性呼吸衰竭（BTS/ICS 2016：pH < 7.35 且 PaCO₂ > 6.5 kPa），不用于代谢性酸中毒的代偿；镇静，或分钟通气量低于他自己的机械通气，都会去掉这份代偿，使 pH 骤降；他近几天呕吐、纵隔有气，正压面罩还会增加误吸和张力性气胸的风险。
teachingPoints.en: Protect the compensation. Winter's formula (expected PaCO₂ = 1.5 × HCO₃⁻ + 8 ± 2) gives about 10.7–14.7 mmHg, and his 10 mmHg is at the limit. NIV treats hypercapnic respiratory failure (BTS/ICS 2016: pH < 7.35 with PaCO₂ > 6.5 kPa), not the compensation of a metabolic acidosis; sedation, or mechanical ventilation at a lower minute volume than he generates himself, removes the compensation and the pH falls sharply, and after days of vomiting, with air in his mediastinum, a positive-pressure mask adds aspiration and tension pneumothorax.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 第一个小时：等渗液（无低血压时首小时约 1 L），固定速率静脉胰岛素 0.1 单位/(kg·h)、不推注；血钾 3.5–5.5 mmol/L 时每升液体加钾 40 mmol（JBDS-IP 2023；2024 年共识认为多数人每升 20–30 mmol 即可），< 3.5 mmol/L 时先补钾、推迟胰岛素；pH ≥ 7.0 不用碳酸氢钠（2024 年共识）；血糖 < 14 mmol/L 时加 10% 葡萄糖，胰岛素继续。报告与现行做法：报告记录了补液和胰岛素，但本病例没有记录方案、补钾，也没有记录是否用过碱剂。
teachingPoints.en: The first hour: isotonic fluid (about 1 L in the first hour without hypotension) and a fixed-rate insulin infusion at 0.1 units/kg/h with no bolus; potassium 40 mmol in each litre while it is 3.5–5.5 mmol/L (JBDS-IP 2023; the 2024 consensus finds 20–30 mmol/L enough for most), and potassium first with insulin delayed below 3.5 mmol/L; no bicarbonate at pH 7.0 or above (2024 consensus); 10 % glucose once the glucose falls below 14 mmol/L, with the insulin continued. Then and now: the report records fluids and insulin, but this case does not record the regimen, any potassium, or whether alkali was given.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 把钠和血糖放在一起读。钠 112 mmol/L、血糖 26.3 mmol/L：按血糖每高出 5.6 mmol/L 钠加 1.6 mmol/L 校正约为 118 mmol/L，按加 2.4 约为 121 mmol/L；有效渗透压约 250 mOsm/kg——真性低渗性低钠。只用等渗液，大约每 2 小时查钠并计算校正钠（血糖下降时实测钠会上升），校正钠在第 1 个 24 小时的上升控制在约 10 mmol/L 以内（2014 年欧洲低钠血症指南）。他 25 岁，正处于 JBDS 要求做神经系统观察、警惕脑水肿的 18–25 岁年龄段。本病例只记录了到院时的一次血钠。
teachingPoints.en: Read the sodium with the glucose. Sodium 112 mmol/L with glucose 26.3 mmol/L corrects to about 118 mmol/L (+1.6 mmol/L per 5.6 mmol/L of glucose above 5.6) or 121 mmol/L (+2.4), with an effective osmolality near 250 mOsm/kg — a true hypotonic hyponatraemia. Use isotonic fluid only, check the sodium and its corrected value about every 2 hours (the measured value climbs as the glucose falls), and keep the rise in corrected sodium within about 10 mmol/L in the first 24 hours (European hyponatraemia guideline 2014). At 25 he is in the 18–25 age band in which JBDS asks for neurological observations for cerebral oedema. Only the admission sodium is recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 呕吐后的颈胸部握雪感：先排除食管破裂。WSES 2019 食管急症指南以 CT（结合口服造影剂）作为疑似穿孔的首选检查；排除之前禁食、请胸外科会诊，内镜放在 CT 之后。CT 显示纵隔气肿而无裂口时，多为肺泡破裂引起的自发性纵隔气肿，以治疗诱因、禁食和观察为主；颈部切开或皮下引流只用于积气危及气道、呼吸或循环时。报告与现行做法：报告记录了胃肠减压和颈部引流，CT 之后还做了胃镜；本病例没有记录颈部引流的指征。
teachingPoints.en: Crepitus after vomiting: exclude oesophageal rupture first. The WSES 2019 guidelines on oesophageal emergencies make CT with oral contrast the first test for suspected perforation; keep him nil by mouth and involve thoracic surgery until it is excluded, and leave endoscopy until after the CT. A pneumomediastinum without a tear is usually spontaneous, from alveolar rupture, and is managed by treating the cause, nil by mouth and observation; cervical incisions or subcutaneous drains are for air that threatens the airway, breathing or circulation. Then and now: the report records gastric decompression and cervical drainage, and a gastroscopy after the CT; this case does not record why the neck was drained.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 安全过渡并明确分型。2024 年共识：血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L 且静脉 pH ≥ 7.3 或 HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18 mmol/L 为纠正，停泵前 1–2 小时皮下注射基础胰岛素。ADA 2026 糖尿病诊疗标准建议对疑似 1 型糖尿病的成人检测胰岛自身抗体，而不是凭一次发作定型，并且不主张单用纠正剂量胰岛素；出院前完成教育和生病期间规则。报告与现行做法：报告记录化验恢复、约 2 周出院、随访 2 年未复发，但本病例没有记录出院方案和分型依据。
teachingPoints.en: Step down safely and classify. The 2024 consensus: resolution is ketones < 0.6 mmol/L with venous pH ≥ 7.3 or bicarbonate ≥ 18 mmol/L, and subcutaneous basal insulin goes in 1–2 hours before the infusion stops. The ADA Standards of Care 2026 advise islet autoantibodies in adults with suspected type 1 diabetes rather than typing from one episode, and discourage correction insulin on its own; education and sick-day rules come before discharge. Then and now: the report records recovered laboratory values, discharge after about two weeks and no recurrence over two years, but this case does not record his discharge regimen or how his diabetes was classified.

unknowns.zh-CN: 到院时的血压、体温、经皮血氧饱和度和意识状态（GCS），以及他的体重。
unknowns.en: His blood pressure, temperature, oxygen saturation and conscious level (GCS) on arrival, and his weight.

unknowns.zh-CN: 其余化验：血 β-羟丁酸、氯（阴离子间隙）、尿素和血浆渗透压、乳酸、血常规（血红蛋白）、淀粉酶或脂肪酶，以及治疗期间的任何复查值。
unknowns.en: The rest of the laboratory picture: blood β-hydroxybutyrate, chloride (anion gap), urea and osmolality, lactate, full blood count (haemoglobin), amylase or lipase, and any repeat value during treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: 尿酮 14.4 mmol/L 的检测方法（试纸还是定量测定），以及血糖的采样方式。
unknowns.en: How the urine ketones of 14.4 mmol/L were measured (strip or quantitative assay), and how the glucose was sampled.

unknowns.zh-CN: 胸片和心电图；CT 的扫描时间、是否用造影剂、有无气胸或胸腔积液；胃镜的时间和出血来源。
unknowns.en: Any chest X-ray or ECG; when the CT was done, whether it used contrast and whether it showed a pneumothorax or effusion; when the gastroscopy was done and the source of bleeding.

unknowns.zh-CN: 治疗细节：液体种类和量、胰岛素方案、补钾、是否用过碱剂，以及颈部引流的时间、方法和指征。
unknowns.en: Treatment details: fluid type and volumes, the insulin regimen, potassium, whether alkali was given, and the timing, method and indication of the cervical drainage.

unknowns.zh-CN: 糖尿病分型的依据（胰岛自身抗体、C 肽、HbA1c）、出院时的降糖方案和随访内容。
unknowns.en: The basis for classifying his diabetes (islet autoantibodies, C-peptide, HbA1c), his treatment at discharge and what follow-up involved.

unknowns.zh-CN: 胸痛、吞咽痛、发热、多尿等症状，以及用药、过敏、家族史、吸烟饮酒和其他物质使用情况。
unknowns.en: Symptoms such as chest pain, painful swallowing, fever or polyuria, and his medicines, allergies, family history, smoking, alcohol and other substance use.
